description: Danish company officers and directors, live from CVR, the official Danish company registry (Erhvervsstyrelsen): executive board (Direktion), board of directors (Bestyrelse) with deputies and how each member was elected, fully liable partners of an I/S or K/S, and auditors: name, body, role and mandate dates. Active mandates by default; inclure_anciens adds ended mandates, which is where founders (stiftere) normally are. Long boards are capped at 300 active / 200 ended mandates, flagged by `tronque` (the counts stay exact). Beneficial owners (reelle ejere) are NOT exposed by this access and are never guessed. GDPR minimisation: no address, no personal identifier, and the register publishes no date of birth here. A sole proprietorship (ENK, PMV), an estate (DØD) or an undecided CVR form returns 404, not billed: neither the entity nor its owner is served. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

inclure_anciens.description: Also return ended mandates, each with its end date

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
